responsibility: Provides rustc’s low-level LLVM integration layer on the Rust side. In its root file, this crate supplies the FFI support that the in-tree C++ LLVM glue depends on by defining the opaque RustString bridge used for writing into Rust-owned buffers and exporting the corresponding write entry point for direct linkage from the C++ side. The root file also owns initialization of the LLVM backend targets compiled into the build, gathering the cfg-controlled target-registration calls into one place. Together, these responsibilities make the crate the compiler’s boundary layer for basic Rust/C++ interoperation with LLVM and for bringing the selected LLVM code generation targets online.
